passed.conclusion: Real persistent App/Room lock/agentWriteMu/trusted task/registry/audit/GORM transaction plus separately timed real snapshot preserve the relevant transaction path. Frozen repeated effect and state are explicitly a synthetic tool load, not 50 learning opportunities or a full classroom.

Serial workload, no periodic timers/models/network, synchronized observation hooks and explicit sampler shutdown keep the comparison bounded. Plan does not claim concurrent-student latency. Sampler disturbance and maximum/cumulative sampling time are reported.

Parent 180s wall clock includes initialization and final validation; owned-only termination handles unresponsive COMMIT. Fixed denominator50, started/finished, separate tool commit and snapshot outcome, unknown in-flight and validation_complete prevent false rollback/success claims. Overflow has bounded drain and explicit failure.
Bounded summaries and function names only; no SQL, audio, text, arguments or file paths. Current-PID counters and owned WAL stat avoid unrelated process data. Raw stacks remain memory-only.

Actual pool PRAGMA establishes observed connection settings, not fsync latency or proof of every future physical connection. DBStats pool waits differ from SQLite lock waits; IO includes non-database operations; WAL allocated length is not frame/commit count. Plan explicitly avoids causal overclaim.
